Since \(33^{-1} \equiv 77 \pmod{508}\), we have

\[
33 \cdot 77 \equiv 1 \pmod{508}.
\]

But \(33 = 3 \cdot 11\), so

\[
(3 \cdot 11)\cdot 77 \equiv 1 \pmod{508}.
\]

Thus

\[
11 \cdot (3\cdot 77) \equiv 1 \pmod{508}.
\]

Now

\[
3\cdot 77 = 231.
\]

So

\[
11 \cdot 231 \equiv 1 \pmod{508}.
\]

Therefore,

\[
11^{-1} \equiv 231 \pmod{508}.
\]

The answer is 231.
